text.tspan: How to answer a networking question: five steps
Say what you do know, how you'd find out (the command or the document) and what you'd expect to see.
"I'm not sure of the exact default, but I'd check sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_time" is a good answer;
a confident guess is a bad one.
